stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260730 from start SHA-256 ea5f0e1743f54d1c4d49dbd235a1fe263eed462719ba95e75a9da0dc5be7f089.
Enumerate all 6054 legal neighbors per sweep and compute the exact 166-shift objective through the frozen 56-class weight partition.
Use tenures 7 through 14 and perturb the global best with exactly 64 legal random moves only after 5000 stagnant sweeps.

Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another start, seed, tenure, perturbation length, restart threshold, objective, or cap.
Run the independent full-result audit before interpretation.
Do not promote a lower nonzero score.
